identity: A connected home and media console with controls for room temperature, bulb settings, schedules, music queues, and video playback position.

scenarios.name: thermostat
scenarios.screen: One room’s thermostat shows a setpoint dial, Heat and Cool controls, the current room temperature, humidity, and an operating status. A legal setpoint and one mode are selected.
never: A temperature setpoint outside the dial’s printed range
An open time picker
A list of multiple room thermostats
A temperature history chart

arrangements.text: The setpoint dial sits above the Heat and Cool controls, with room measurements below them.
The setpoint dial sits left of the Heat and Cool controls, with room measurements beneath the controls.

scenarios.name: lightcolor
scenarios.screen: One room’s bulb has a circular hue control and a brightness control, each showing a current value. A connection status is visible.
never: A separate color picker popup open on load
A grid of bulbs from multiple rooms
A schedule editor
A brightness value above 100%

arrangements.text: The circular hue control sits above the brightness control, with the connection status below.
The circular hue control sits left of the brightness control, with the connection status alongside the controls.

scenarios.name: scene
scenarios.screen: A named schedule shows a filled time field, seven repeat-day controls, and four device rows with On, Off, and excluded choices. The time picker is closed, and Save schedule is available.
never: The time picker open on load
A saved confirmation already showing
A device outside the connected device list
A calendar of dates in place of weekday controls

arrangements.text: The scene name and time sit above the repeat days, followed by the device rows and Save schedule.
The scene name, time, and repeat days sit left of the device rows, with Save schedule below the rows.

scenarios.name: playlist
scenarios.screen: A single queue contains several tracks, each with a title, artist, and duration, plus a queue duration. All tracks begin in the queue; none is being dragged.
never: A track floating outside the queue on load
Duplicate copies of a queued track
An open track picker
A video timeline

arrangements.text: The tracks form one vertical queue with the queue duration below it.
The tracks form one vertical queue with the queue duration above it.

scenarios.name: scrub
scenarios.screen: A paused video shows its title, a seek timeline with chapter markers, the current position, and time remaining. No hover preview is open.
never: Video playing on load
A hover preview open without a pointer over the timeline
A position beyond the video duration
An editable chapter list

arrangements.text: The video title sits above the seek timeline; chapter markers lie on the timeline, with position and time remaining below it.
The video title sits left of the seek timeline; chapter markers lie on the timeline, with position and time remaining at its ends.
